dateClassification.note: FUTBIN historical evolution pages do not expose a per-task absolute release date; tasks are therefore grouped into the verified inclusive range without inventing daily dates.

tasks.description: Welcome to FC 26! Kick things off by exploring Evolutions, where you can upgrade Players over time until they reach their stated maximum.
